about.title: Engineering with precision, curiosity, and solid foundations.
about.p1: I am a Software Engineer and Mobile Developer with a strong academic foundation (graduating with a 3.95 GPA as the Best Graduate in Information Systems) and proven hands-on experience in building scalable Android and full-stack solutions.
about.p2: My journey includes completing the prestigious Bangkit Academy (led by Google, GoTo, and Traveloka) with Distinction in Mobile Development. I focus on clean architecture, performance optimization, and integrating AI capabilities—such as Google Gemini—into practical, impactful real-world applications.
about.p3: Whether architecting native Kotlin Android applications with MVVM or building high-efficiency web applications, I bring disciplined engineering practices, proactive problem-solving, and a dedication to high standards.

items.title: BAST V2
